title: Director, Platform Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Leads a platform group; develops strategies and plans that standardize runtimes, APIs, and SDKs across several teams. Accountable for group results and governance adherence; makes operational decisions ensuring compatibility, security, and performance. Sponsors cross-group innovation in resilience, capacity modeling, and interoperability. Communicates with executive leadership on platform health, risk, and adoption.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Software Development:**

* Define platform strategy for a group, aligning runtimes, SDKs, and integration frameworks to interoperable, multi-tenant standards.
* Govern cross-group compatibility and security controls with SRE/security partners; approve high-risk migrations and deprecations.
* Own group-wide resilience and capacity objectives; institutionalize rollout, canary, and rollback patterns across services.

**Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:**

* Defines key elements for leads and/or teams to design multiple software solutions and identify and analyze requirements to ensure alignment with business and organizational goals.
* Applies broad understanding of other areas within the organization to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code.
* Leads design and specification reviews to drive improvements across multiple projects/programs.
* Utilizes conceptual thinking to direct leads and/or teams for conducting debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues.
* Directs leads and/or teams to implement software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
* Drives the optimization of design and development practices to improve performance across products and domains, ensuring adherence to organizational goals in execution of business priorities.
* Directs teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
* Directs teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

**Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:**

* Directs teams to design and develop software, systems, and services.
* Coaches managers to provide technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices.
* Utilizes conceptual thinking to direct teams in conducting periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards.
* Collaborates with cross-functional teams and stakeholders within and outside the organization to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus.
* Directs teams to implement performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
* Defines processes and approaches to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements.

**Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:**

* Collaborates with stakeholders within and outside of organization, including executive leadership, to understand customer issues and align solutions.
* Directs teams to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues.
* Leads teams and sets direction to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
* Influences multiple teams to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
* Directs the implementation of training for customer issue and/or defect handling processes.
* Leads the investigation and troubleshooting of complex and broadly reaching product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions.

**Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:**

* Collaborates with teams and leadership to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, evolving/dynamic industry best practices and processes, and coding standards.
* Ensures clarity on key elements and objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria to impact development processes in the organization.
* Implements complex secure software development practices to prevent security vulnerabilities that affect the organization.

**Development Operations - System Maintenance:**

* Defines key elements for teams to perform periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
* Ensures teams are aware of and adhere to service contract, terms, and conditions.
* Directs teams to proactively evolve standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and to drive improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Oversees and guides multiple teams on managing complex projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable to ensure strategic objectives are met. Serves as a role model for appropriately delegating work, setting priorities, and ensuring alignment with business needs. Coaches others on adjusting resources or project timelines in anticipation of business changes.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Role models leading cross-functional collaborative efforts to ensure alignment of expectations and strategic objectives. Empowers team to build and maintain partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to address barriers and contribute to organizational success. Drives transparency and inclusivity by modeling actively seeking, listening to, and leveraging diverse perspectives.

**Problem Solving:**

* Shares problem-solving strategies across teams, providing oversight on complex operational and/or technical issues, as needed. Coaches teams on analyzing highly complex data and/or information to identify solutions to ambiguous issues and provides direction on identifying root causes to prevent recurrence of issues.

Creates opportunities for team members and leaders to build their expertise in new areas, coaching them to build innovative skills. Identifies skill gap trends across the organization, and upholds a culture that places significant emphasis on sharing knowledge and pursuing learning opportunities that advance the organization. Evaluates efficiency of learning strategies and recommends adjustments as needed.

* Empowers team to own the development and implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the department. title: Senior NetSuite Integration Architect
description:
**About the Company:**

Relay Human Cloud is a young & dynamic company that helps some of the top US-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting & Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high-quality operations in cutting-edge companies for their entire careers.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Manager – Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture with strong NetSuite integration expertise to design, develop, and maintain enterprise integrations, APIs, EDI, and data pipelines. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills and a solid understanding of distribution, inventory, order processing, and accounting workflows. This role focuses on hands-on implementation, troubleshooting, and long-term technical ownership rather than project management.

**Responsibilities:**

**Enterprise integration architecture**

* Design and maintain the company's enterprise integration architecture, including approved patterns for APIs, EDI, webhooks, SFTP, files, native connectors, events, and batch processing.
* Define source and target systems, authoritative data boundaries, field mappings, timing, sequencing, validation, error handling, retry, reconciliation, security, and support ownership for each interface.
* Avoid uncontrolled point-to-point connections, duplicated business logic, and integrations that create parallel systems of record.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, interface inventories, mapping specifications, decision records, and runbooks while determining which existing interfaces should be retained, redesigned, replaced, or retired.

**NetSuite integration engineering**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support integrations between NetSuite and internal or external systems.
* Develop deep knowledge of the NetSuite record, transaction, permission, and posting models so interfaces create valid operational and accounting results.
* Work with applicable NetSuite capabilities such as REST web services, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, SuiteScript, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, web services, and token-based authentication.
* Use Oracle integration technologies where appropriate, establish reusable engineering patterns, and challenge partner-proposed designs before owning the deployed solution and support model.

**Customer vendor and external ecosystem integration**

* Support EDI and API connectivity for customers, broadline distributors, vendors, logistics providers, marketplaces, payment services, websites, and other business partners.
* Design mappings and workflows for relevant documents such as purchase orders, acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory updates, item data, pricing, and order status.
* Support vendor onboarding, customer enablement, item synchronization, pricing exchange, order ingestion, fulfillment status, and other digital transaction flows while keeping partner-specific rules documented and controlled.
* Build repeatable onboarding patterns that reduce the cost and time required to connect new customers, vendors, and acquisitions.

**Data architecture ownership and governance**

* Help define company's enterprise data architecture with NetSuite as the authoritative transactional platform for the processes it owns.
* Establish clear boundaries for transactional, master, analytical, historical, reference, and external application data.
* Partner with business and application owners to define authoritative sources, data ownership, approval rights, stewardship, quality rules, and lifecycle requirements.
* Design governed data pipelines, transformation logic, shared definitions, and reconciliations so critical item, pricing, costing, inventory, margin, customer, vendor, and financial logic remains transparent and auditable.

**Legacy discovery migration and transition**

* Inspect legacy applications, databases, scripts, interfaces, files, and automated jobs to identify embedded business rules and technical dependencies.
* Document why existing functionality exists before replacing it, separating requirements that must be preserved from obsolete workarounds and technical debt.
* Support extraction, transformation, mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with repeatable utilities and control totals that preserve financial, operational, and referential integrity.
* Plan retirement, archival, access, and support arrangements for legacy data and applications that will not move into the future environment.

**Analytics data services and application enablement**

* Support the architecture and ongoing operation of NetSuite Analytics Warehouse and related analytics capabilities where adopted.
* Define the appropriate roles of NetSuite native reporting, governed analytical platforms, Power BI, and other reporting tools so business logic is not recreated inconsistently.
* Design data models and pipelines that provide trusted reporting and reconcile to source transactions.
* Support approved extension platforms for internal tools, portals, and workflows, and enable automation or AI only through governed data, controlled interfaces, clear ownership, and appropriate human review.

**Testing monitoring security and operational support**

* Develop and execute unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, failure-mode, cutover, and reconciliation testing with documented acceptance criteria.

* Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. title: Head of Enterprise Architecture
description:
The Head of Enterprise Architecture will act as the custodian of technology architecture for Adani Group, holding end\-to\-end accountability for defining, governing and evolving the Group's technology blueprint across its diversified portfolio of independently operating businesses.
 



 As custodian of architecture across the Group, the role holds the mandate to ensure that technology investments made independently by each business remain strategically aligned, secure, scalable, interoperable, cost\-efficient and designed for reuse. The role chairs the Group Architecture Review Board as the Group's principal governance checkpoint for major technology decisions, and is accountable for the disciplined evaluation of new and emerging technologies before they are adopted at scale.
 



 The role will work closely with Group leadership, Business CDOs/CTOs, the Group CISO and Cyber team, and transformation leaders to evolve the organization from application\-centric technology landscapes toward a platform\-, data\- and API\-driven enterprise architecture.
 



 The role partners closely with the Group's AI Labs, Cloud Engineering and Data organization, aligning their platforms and roadmaps to the wider enterprise architecture, while those functions retain ownership of their respective domains.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as the Group's custodian of enterprise architecture: own the Group Enterprise Architecture strategy, principles, standards, reference architectures and the 3–5 year technology roadmap, applied consistently across every Adani Group business.
* Chair the Group Architecture Review Board (ARB) — the central governance body for enterprise technology decisions:
* Set the ARB's review criteria, escalation thresholds and decision rights, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards without slowing day\-to\-day business execution.
* Maintain the ARB as the final sign\-off authority for cross\-business platform, cloud, data and cybersecurity architecture decisions.
* Own the evaluation of new and emerging technologies for the Group:
* Maintain an Enterprise Technology Radar and a documented evaluation framework (business fit, security, cost, interoperability, vendor viability) to assess candidate technologies.
* Systematically move promising technologies — spanning cloud, data platforms, cybersecurity, integration, edge and IoT/OT — from evaluation to proof\-of\-concept, production pilot and Group\-wide adoption.
* Act as the final architectural authority on technology and vendor selection decisions referred to the ARB.
* Establish and lead a federated architecture model that provides Group\-level direction while enabling individual businesses — Ports, Airports, Power, Green Energy, Cement, Gas Distribution and Data Centers — to retain appropriate technology autonomy.
* Drive standardization and reuse of platforms, APIs, data products, integration patterns, cloud foundations, identity, observability and common technology services across all Group businesses.
* Establish architecture principles for hybrid cloud, edge computing, high\-performance compute infrastructure, IoT and industrial/OT environments, reflecting the Group's asset\-intensive businesses.
* Drive technology economics and rationalization across the Group, reducing duplicated platforms, unnecessary licenses, technical debt and long\-term total cost of ownership (TCO).
* Build and lead a high\-calibre central Enterprise Architecture team, and develop a federated architecture community of practice across Adani Group businesses.



**Key Success Measures** 




 Success will be measured through Group\-wide business and technology outcomes, including:
 


* Throughput and turnaround time of decisions reviewed by the Architecture Review Board.
* Proportion of new technologies moved from Technology Radar evaluation through PoC to production and Group\-wide scale.
* Increased reuse and reduced duplication of platforms, data products and technical debt across businesses.
* Improved interoperability between business\-unit systems and Group\-level platforms.
* Lower Group\-wide technology TCO and stronger resilience and cybersecurity posture.
* Consistency of security\-by\-design outcomes, validated jointly with the CISO/Cyber team, across ARB decisions.

 Key Responsibilities

Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability.  We are looking for a systems\-minded developer with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience who is comfortable

 across a cloud\-native deployment. The ideal candidate has worked in the observability domain — metrics,
 



 logs, traces, time\-series storage and enjoys owning a module end to end. This is a high\-ownership role in a
 



 small, fast\-moving team. You will work across multiple modules, make design calls, use AI\-assisted
 



 development as a daily tool, and be accountable for what you ship in production.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibility:** 




  





**•** 
 Build and scale services for operational data ingestion, enrichment, storage, and query in a
 



 multitenant SaaS environment — spanning push\-based telemetry (metrics, logs, traces), polland protocol\-based collection (SNMP, WMI, SSH, ICMP), event streams (traps, syslog, flow), and
 



 discovery and inventory data.
 



 • Work with event/message\-driven pipelines (NATS) and time\-series, relational, and cache
 



 stores.
 



 • Design ingestion paths that handle heterogeneous sources and cadences — high\-volume
 



 streaming, scheduled polling cycles, bursty event traffic, and transactional API writes — each

 conventions where they fit and defining consistent conventions where they don't, so
 



 downstream consumers see one shape regardless of source.

 Own system design for your modules — write and defend design notes covering data
 



 model, interfaces, scaling limits, failure modes, and rollback.
